name: Grip Candidates
description: Pitches whose spin twins get different movement and better results with the same spin.
explanation: Spin twins throw the same pitch with nearly the same speed, spin for the speed, spin efficiency, and spin direction.
With the spin matched, most of the difference in movement is seam effect. These pitches move differently from twins who get better results (run value per 100 pitches).

Listed when at least 3 tight twins (and a third of them) do better, the gap is 1.5 inches or more and within what seams plausibly explain, and the pitch spins at least 60% efficiently (below that, spin direction is too hard to measure to isolate seams). This says there's movement left on the table, not how to grip the ball.
